row.notes: vehicle_newlap_recorded handler of the telemetry laps (rcx laps, rdx msg: +0x10 u8 car, +0x18 u8 gate for the ranking and the lap start, +0x1c f32 lap s); subscribed by Game_TelemetryLaps_CreateLaps at 0x1437af554 (name 'vehicle_newlap_recorded' at 0x1437af562) and again at 0x1437b1216. Telemetry lap vector laps+0x50..+0x58: slot 0 the lap being driven, slot 1 the previous lap, slot 2 the previous best, slot 3 the best. Returns at once unless laps+0xa80 and +0xa81 are set and slot 0's car (+0x130 -> +0xe8) is msg+0x10. Calls Game_TelemetryLaps_ApplyLapValidity_Thunk 0x142923d40 on the validity component (0x1437b0c0c) and stores the lap time in slot 0's summary (+0x268, 0x1437b0d5d). The ranking (0x1437b0e00..0x1437b0ef2) reads bit 0 of the summary flags +0x2c0 as not clean: a clean lap beats a slower not-clean best, and a faster lap beats the best when it is clean or when both laps share a flags bit. Slot 0 also replaces slot 3 when slot 3 has no time, slot 3+0x214 is 0, bit 3 of slot 3's flags is set, laps+0xa85 is set, or slot 0 is faster and bit 1 of slot 3's flags is set; it replaces it only while slot 0+0x250 is 0 (Game_TelemetryLap_CopyFrom 0x1437acec0 at 0x1437b0e6e), and then posts the new personal best message carrying bit 1 of the old best's flags. With msg+0x18 set it ends with the lap start body (thunk 0x1437b2b00 at 0x1437b0f05: slot 1 = copy of slot 0, slot 2 = copy of slot 3, slot 0 cleared with flags &= 0xf0, then the validity thunk again). Steam 1.0.145 0x1437b3030 and EA 1.0.145 0x1437a02e0 (restored dump): 267 of 267 instructions the same, +0x2c0/+0x268/+0x250/+0x18 used at the same places.
